svg.aria-label: VERSION: The overdrive CLI versions ~/.claude as a local git repo and pins every tool repo by SHA in one lock file. MODS: overdrive-tabs draws a tab band above the prompt. overdrive-tools colors every tool row and folds it. LOOK: An output style, a session banner and a five-row statusline share one neon palette and one art language
